title: Elite: Beacon Stairs Above Silence: Threshold Sign
description: Beacon Stairs Above Silence unfolds across floating beacon stairways with glass bridges and radiant lock sigils, pushing a one active Titan Empyrean Titan to prove protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, battle lineless aura play. without violating established Realm canon. Appearance rule: Radiant Hierarchies is the source culture humans later copied as angelic hierarchy and heavenly myth; mission terrain and cosmetics must show white-gold radiance, many-eye halos, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometry, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire.
lore: This mission treats Radiant Hierarchies as the origin behind angelic hierarchy and heavenly myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use white-gold radiance, many-eye halos, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometry, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: floating beacon stairways with glass bridges and radiant lock sigils; source-culture appearance layer: choir vault ascents, bell platforms, ophanim wheel lanes, throne-judgment stairs, living scroll seal floors, glass-light bridges; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: seraph bell-edict blades, opal-glass cherubim aegis, ophanim many-eye choir cores, wheel intercept silhouettes

Hold every objective for one full enemy turn
Trigger at least one Momentum or Divinity decision before victory

specialRules: Hymn Resonance: Divinity builds when the Titan chains ability timing with sacred echoes.
Choir Lock: beacon timing shields battle line if objectives resolve in order.
Radiant Edict: structured actions reduce chaos effects and protect allies.
Elite Hazard: secondary realm pressure starts active.
Elite Command: enemy support persists until objective action breaks the source.
Solo Titanic Scale: one active Titan occupies the tactical focus; enemies, elites, and bosses scale around that single presence.
victoryConditions: Complete Elite: Beacon Stairs Above Silence: Threshold Sign with one active Titan while reading floating beacon stairways with glass bridges and radiant lock sigils and preserving faction doctrine.
